title: Big 30 Question-Specific Guides
description: Specific planners and follow-ups for the existing Big 30 page. Replace the current one-size-fits-all planner.

items.question: Tell me about yourself.
items.purpose: Create a friendly overview, not a full life history.
supportFrames: Most of my experience is in…
items.followUpQuestion: What got you interested in that?
items.commonTrap: Listing too many facts without a clear focus.

practiceStages.follow: Use the key points and full support frames.
practiceStages.recall: Use keywords and only the first words of the frames.
practiceStages.free: Answer with no written sentences, then respond to the follow-up.
